_doc: visemes-v1 edit costs for visemes.viseme_distance(a, b). sub keys are '<code in a>|<code in b>' (e.g. "P|F": 0.6); an entry also covers the reverse unless the reverse is listed. Unlisted pairs cost default_sub; same code costs 0. ins = code only in b, del = code only in a. All costs in [0, 1].
